name: fitness_coach_simple_v1
description: Simple evaluation dataset for fitness coach conversation agent

test_cases.description: User asks about their current workout plan

messages.content: What workouts do I have this week?

expectations.expected_behavior: Agent should use the query_agent (database query) to retrieve the user's workout schedule for the current week. Should present the information clearly and ask if the user wants more details about any specific workout. Should be encouraging and supportive.

test_cases.description: User wants to adjust their plan due to injury

messages.content: I hurt my shoulder doing overhead press yesterday. Can we modify my workouts to avoid shoulder pain?

expectations.expected_behavior: Agent should express concern about the injury and recommend seeing a healthcare provider if pain is severe. Should offer to temporarily modify the plan to avoid overhead pressing movements and replace them with shoulder-friendly alternatives. Should ask about pain severity and range of motion. Tone should be cautious and health-first.
